propositions: Ticket directory creation races between mkdir and first event file write, leaving fsck-visible debris (empty dirs) if interrupted between those steps.

New staging module atomically creates ticket directory and initial event file together using renamed staging paths with dot-prefix naming convention, making temp paths invisible to existing fsck scanners.
Both single-event stage_and_commit and batch_stage_and_commit paths now use StagedEvent to stage events, then promote under write lock with one os.rename for atomicity.

Sweep mechanism cleans stale staging directories owned by dead processes at writer start, using process-start-time stamp to prevent pid-recycling confusion, without violating 043f's reader-tolerates-never-tidies principle.
AC4 audit converted three other dir-then-file sites (batch_stage_and_commit, inbound_translate._write_event_file, dispatch_one BRIDGE_ALERT) and documented eight exempt sites with reasons.
